price_basis: Per ADS (1 ADS = 8 ordinary shares). Verified live from Yahoo Finance 2026-06-30.

historical_growth.fcf_cagr_note: FY2026 FCF was -RMB 46,609M (negative trough driven by RMB 126B AI capex and quick-commerce subsidies). Standard CAGR cannot be computed from a negative terminal value. FCF history FY2020-FY2026: [130,910; 172,663; 98,874; 171,663; 156,210; 73,870; -46,609] RMB M. FY2020-FY2025 average = RMB 134,032M. Normalized base = RMB 120,000M (10% haircut to reflect near-term capex overhang).
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (2.5%) is far below Revenue 5yr CAGR (7.4%). Divergence is explained by: (1) massive share buybacks reducing equity base (shares fell from 21,408M in FY2021 to 19,319M in FY2026), (2) FY2026 investment cycle compressing retained earnings. Per the trough-FCF framework, equity CAGR is not used as the primary growth anchor — FCF recovery trajectory is modeled explicitly by scenario. FCF CAGR is flagged N/A due to negative terminal year.

valuation_philosophy.approach: Trough-FCF Mid-Cycle Normalization with Exit-Multiple Cap
valuation_philosophy.summary: FY2026 is an intentional investment trough — not structural demand decline. Alibaba deployed RMB 126B in AI/cloud capex (part of a stated RMB 380B+ three-year programme) and poured subsidies into Taobao Instant Commerce to compete with Meituan, collapsing FCF to a RMB 46,609M outflow. These are discretionary investment choices. Anchoring the DCF base year on FY2026 reported FCF would systematically under-value the business (the inverse of the classic peak-FCF trap). The model instead uses a NORMALIZED (mid-cycle) FCF base of RMB 120,000M: a 10% discount to the FY2020-FY2025 average of RMB 134,032M, reflecting continued elevated capex through FY2028. Bull case uses RMB 140,000M (toward FY2024 levels if cloud inflects faster). Bear case uses RMB 70,000M (near FY2025 trough if subsidy war persists). An exit-multiple cap (min of Gordon Growth TV vs EV/EBITDA cap on normalized EBITDA) prevents any scenario from implying multiples the market has never paid for BABA. This cap is binding in the base and bull cases.

wacc_rationale.note: Base 11.5% = 4.5% risk-free + 5.0% ERP + 1.5% China/VIE/regulatory + 0.5% Pentagon CMC + 0.5% Anthropic litigation overhang. Bull case (10.5%) assumes geopolitical risks resolved. Bear case (13.0%) assumes China-US tensions escalate and Pentagon designation triggers forced institutional selling.

exit_multiple_cap.ebitda_basis_note: Average of FY2023 (175,710), FY2024 (191,668), and FY2025 (202,325) Adjusted EBITDA — representing Alibaba's EBITDA in non-trough years. Projected to Y5 at 60% of FCF growth rates per year, then multiplied by exit multiple. Terminal value = min(Gordon Growth TV, exit multiple TV).
exit_multiple_cap.rationale: Historical EV/EBITDA range: 5.4x (FY2024) to 11.8x (FY2025) in recent normal years; stated usable 10yr max 12x. Base at 9x (within range), bull at 12x (historical max), bear at 6x (near historical floor). Exit cap is binding in base and bull cases.

base.fcf_base_description: Normalized mid-cycle FCF; 10% discount to FY2020-FY2025 average of 134,032M to reflect continued AI capex through FY2028
base.growth_narrative: Y1 (+25%): FCF begins recovering as quick-commerce subsidies moderate and cloud AI revenue scales (cloud growing 34% in FY2026, accelerating). Y2 (+20%): AIDC reaches break-even, removing headwind. Y3-Y4 (+15%/+10%): capex intensity plateaus, incremental AI revenue flows to FCF. Y5 (+7%): deceleration toward terminal growth as e-commerce matures.

bull.fcf_base_description: Higher normalized base toward FY2024 actual FCF level (156,210M), reflecting faster cloud/AI monetization inflection
bull.growth_narrative: Faster cloud/AI commercialization: AI products reach 50%+ of external cloud revenue by FY2028. Quick commerce unit economics improve rapidly (break-even by end FY2027). AIDC profitable in FY2027. Anthropic allegations resolved without penalties. Pentagon CMC designation overturned. FCF recovers sharply.

bear.fcf_base_description: Sustained suppression near FY2025 actual level (73,870M): subsidy war drags on, AI capex stays high
bear.growth_narrative: Subsidy war with Meituan persists through FY2028. Anthropic distillation scandal causes enterprise cloud customer churn and US sanctions restricting API access. Pentagon CMC designation triggers forced institutional selling. FCF recovers slowly from trough. E-commerce market share continues eroding to Douyin and PDD.

valuation.note: All FCF and EV/equity figures in RMB millions. Intrinsic value converted to USD per ADS: (equity_value_rmb_mn / ads_mn) / fx_rmb_per_usd. Net debt = total_debt (259,996) - cash (131,530) = 128,466 RMB M (net debt position, subtracted from EV to get equity value).

base.terminal_value_source: exit_multiple (9x normalized EBITDA Y5; binding because Gordon TV > exit TV at 11.5% WACC)

bull.terminal_value_source: exit_multiple (12x normalized EBITDA Y5; binding because Gordon TV > exit TV at 10.5% WACC)

bear.terminal_value_source: gordon_growth (bear WACC 13% makes Gordon TV < exit multiple TV; Gordon is more conservative in bear)

entry_price.note: All values in USD per ADS. Entry price = terminal_value_per_ads_usd / (1.15)^5.

base.interpretation: Base case entry ($75.26) is 21.2% below the current ADS price of $95.51. The stock is above the 15%-CAGR entry point in the base case but close enough that a 20% correction would bring it to an attractive level for 15% CAGR. The current price implies roughly 9-11% CAGR to the base case terminal value — below the 15% hurdle but not negligible for a deep-value setup.

bull.interpretation: Bull case entry ($113.64) is 19% above current price. If the bull scenario materializes, the current ADS price of $95.51 already provides >15% CAGR, making it an attractive entry point for investors who believe the AI and cloud theses will deliver.

bear.interpretation: Bear case implies severe downside (-64.7% intrinsic value loss). A $23.15 entry price would be required for 15% CAGR in the bear scenario — 76% below current market price. This scenario requires multiple catastrophic risks to materialize simultaneously.

sensitivity.basis: Base case FCF = RMB 120,000M, growth rates Y1-Y5 = [25%, 20%, 15%, 10%, 7%], exit multiple cap 9x normalized EBITDA. Values in USD per ADS.
sensitivity.matrix_note: Exit multiple cap (9x normalized EBITDA Y5 = TV RMB 2,650,243M) is binding at WACC 9.0%-11.5% — at these low WACCs the Gordon Growth TV would be higher, so the cap constrains it and makes values insensitive to terminal growth in those rows. At WACC 12-13%, Gordon Growth TV is lower than the exit cap and terminal growth sensitivity re-emerges. This reflects the disciplined dual-check framework.

probability_weighted.weight_rationale: 25% bear: meaningful but non-dominant probability of prolonged geopolitical escalation (Pentagon listing, Anthropic sanctions, delisting) plus sustained investment cycle without payoff. 50% base: most likely path — gradual FCF normalization over FY2027-FY2029 as cloud scales and QC losses moderate. 25% bull: AI monetization inflects faster than expected, cloud run-rate exceeds US$10B by FY2028, and geopolitical overhang resolves.

implied_multiples.note: EV/EBITDA on trough FY2026 EBITDA (RMB 113,483M) = 19.9x — flagged as trough-year outlier, not a representive sanity bound. Correct comparison uses normalized EBITDA (avg FY2023-FY2025 = RMB 189,901M): 11.9x, within the stated 12x usable maximum.

sanity_check.diagnosis: No hard sanity trip on normalized multiples. P/B 2.00x is within the historical 1.3x-6.1x range and consistent with the recent 3yr average of ~2.15x. Normalized EV/EBITDA 11.9x is just inside the 12x usable max. P/S 2.08x is within recent range. Base case upside (27.2%) does not trigger the '>100% upside + upper-half price' trip — the price ($95.51) is near the 52-week low ($91.99) and in the lower half of the 10yr range.
sanity_check.fix_applied: Exit multiple cap applied as a precautionary discipline even though no hard trip was triggered. Base case 9x exit multiple on normalized EBITDA reduced base IV from $131.48 (uncapped Gordon Growth) to $121.47. The cap ensures no scenario implies EV/EBITDA above the historical maximum. Adjusted base used throughout (sensitivity, entry price, probability-weighted IV).
special_context: FY2026 is a deliberate investment trough — anchoring on reported FCF (-46,609 RMB M) would produce systematic under-valuation. Mid-cycle normalization is methodologically correct.

WACC 11.5% incorporates ~2.5pp China/VIE/regulatory/litigation premium above a US-listed comparable. This is the primary lever — if geopolitical risks resolve, true WACC is closer to 9-10% and base IV rises to $129-135.
EPS-based P/E multiples are not reliable anchors for BABA currently: FY2026 non-GAAP EPS (US$3.70/ADS at 7.25x) and GAAP EPS are both severely depressed by the investment cycle.
Current stock price ($95.51) near 52-week low ($91.99) and in the lower half of the 10yr price range — market already pricing in significant pessimism.
